spans.s:
m. (-ष्णः)
1 A Brahman versed in the Sāma Veda, a chanter of that Veda, which is always to be so recited.
2 An actor, a professional singer.
E.
गै to sing, डिष्ण Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER and preceptor of the gods.
2 A Paṇḍita or learned teacher.
E.
गिर् speech, in the nominative case, गीः and पति master, Visarga becomes स and स is here changed irregularly to ष; the compound however is sometimes written differently, thus गीःपति, गीर्पति or गीस्पति.
